scope: A player-readable documentary reader for nine Utopia rules, six fog correspondences, distinct movement/passed/completed-shop wording, and exactly three independently scoped raw region node-type tables. Existing section341 processed-item dialogue reader is reused, not replaced.

public_documentation.url: https://m.prts.wiki/w/沉沦者的黑流树海/黑流数据库
public_documentation.facts: Nine rule tables; numerical commentary; completed BATTLE_SHOP exception; variation8 explicit community wording addition and footnote; documented layouts and limited main-floor statements. Community supplementation is displayed separately from immutable game descriptions.
All six fog colors and Chinese principle/layout correspondence; three processed-item choices at entry and local action-point exhaustion return. Existing341 owns full dialogue choices.

established_facts: Nine rules are nine exact variationData originals, not nine relics. Red fog lists four candidate rules and never auto-selects one.
Fog assignment for nineteen raw enter scenes uses explicit Chinese fog color plus principle in original scene description; no raw scene/zone suffix is interpreted.

Only the source-table entries zone_portal_normal_5_1/5_2/5_3 declare independent rollNodeData. Each lists INCIDENT/BATTLE_NORMAL/BATTLE_ELITE/BATTLE_SHOP/WISH, without probabilities or concrete event members.
All nineteen same-name portal zones are separate originals. No mapping from their IDs to fog, rule, main-floor or layout is claimed.
Full original game description of variation8 lacks the community-added words 获胜的 and 正式; both texts and footnote are retained, not silently normalized.

variation5 has a movement trigger and wording 其余未经过节点; completed BATTLE_SHOP exclusion comes from public mechanism documentation. Passing a node and completed shop status remain distinct declarations.
rogue_6_bubble_01 is the actual NODE_BUOY 流窜“居民” marker, not a relic. No unrelated ending relic is linked merely because its lore contains 乌托邦.
Source-specific player descriptions include physical/magic versus true damage, stated ranges/durations/caps, and stage/layout restrictions without adding numerical effects to the calculator.
unknowns_and_boundaries: Current server execution, actual entered rule/variant, actual refreshed nodes/results, held items, affected roster and reward settlement are not verified.
Three raw roll-node tables do not prove a universal Utopia pool or variation5 table mapping; absent table means unknown, not no refresh.
Matching manually declared documented floor or movement/pass/shop conditions is a wording comparison only, never full server eligibility or actual trigger.
No probability, actual event membership, hidden refresh scripts, scene-suffix inference, route ranking or live battle placement is added.
No relic correspondence is manufactured for named variations. Node and marker windows are factual original-record readers.
This candidate has not executed formal tests or GUI; parent must install and validate before completing section358.

read_only_targets: current_portal_rules.locate(scenes, exact raw enter scene key)
integration_reference.parent_must_preserve: Provider/source failure clears stale target, child links and content. All owned child windows close with the source panel. No private/run/chat writes.

validation.syntax_validation: Separate actual AST-parse receipt only; no test imports/execution.
